label: TP
reason: User-supplied parameter flows directly into bar via HashMap retrieval without any filtering or encoding, then bar is used as an argument to printf which performs unencoded formatting into the HTTP response header. The presence of X-XSS-Protection: 0 confirms intent to allow script execution, making this a genuine XSS vulnerability.

evidence.note: User parameter retrieved and passed to doSomething, stored in HashMap, retrieved back into bar, then printed via printf into response header without encoding.
Sink location where tainted variable bar is used in printf call.
